usedFor: Acadle holds your learners, and Documint receives each one through “Add Content To Template” when “New User” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Acadle, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A new learner account fills a Documint template, so a welcome document is ready without typing.

watchOut: “New User” in Acadle is polling, so documents appear after a scheduled check, not at sign-up.
